Times of Israel, 15 Oct 2026, 6:11pm Israel time (16:11 BST). Curl blocked; content via WebFetch summary (not verbatim full text).

Headline: Israel said blocking US firm from breaking ground on Gaza base for international force
- A US company won a tender to build an outpost for 150 foreign troops (International Stabilization Force under US-led Board of Peace plan); contractors and trucks blocked from entering Gaza for two months.
- Suspension of private-sector goods: COGAT says Palestinian merchants halted coordination due to Hamas intimidation/taxation; Hamas demands approx NIS 10,000 ($3,200) per truck and requires merchants to sell 30% of goods in cash. Private sector = 50% of trucks entering the Strip.
- COGAT source: "Israel won't open the border... You can't rebuild" [without ISF deployment].
- Gaza trucking union head Nahed Sheheiber: "The merchants are not the ones who stopped the shipments. The Israeli coordinator is claiming that Gaza's merchants are responsible, but the truth is that the Israelis are the ones who imposed the restrictions."
- Board of Peace representative Nickolay Mladenov: "The intimidation of merchants and interference in the supply chain only deepen the suffering of Gaza's civilians."
